# Objective

Preserve the canonical execution record for the G9P integrated analysis,
predesign, roadmap, and author-decision package.

**Executed task record, not a reusable authorization.** The exact author input
is the immutable
`docs/references/cedg/models/g9p/Prompt.md` (raw SHA-256
`b29a919c5c3a7ba781f720d3a9c646f2892c6be19b87419001493481077a9e08`,
canonical-LF SHA-256
`02d05478f719f5e5f14c5ee21d062a7446602721893f85b2f289bfeac700f495`).

# Authority and evidence hierarchy

Use the immutable author prompt, `AGENTS.md`, current source/tests/build,
author-approved G8 specifications/ADRs/evidence, then reference assets and
historical research. This record does not duplicate or supersede that prompt.

# Scope

G9P was design, audit, documentation, schemas/configuration, future prompts, and
verification on `feature/g9-spatial-semantics-design` only.

# Explicitly forbidden scope

No productive G9/public command/GUI/DXF/persistence/bundle-generator change;
no commit, push, tag, promotion, or future-prompt execution.

# Architectural placement

Durable proposals live in specs, ADRs, architecture, validation, roadmap,
guides, and canonical prompts. Executable checks live under `tools/agent`.

# Required design/specification

The output is the G9P package linked from the living roadmap. Every new spec is
`PROPOSED / NOT NORMATIVE` and every new ADR is `Proposed` pending author review.

# Geometric invariants and degeneracies

Preserve constructive traceability, explicit parameters, projection coherence,
stable typed identity, truthful invalid states, and no silent approximation.

# Compatibility and serialization

G8 remains unchanged and author-approved. G9P designs persistence but implements
none. Immutable author assets retain their exact bytes and hashes.

# Required tests and commands

Run the focused G9P verifier, prompt/schema/link/hash checks, historical G8
authority, composed verifier without `-SkipBuild`, and Git whitespace checks.

# Required artifacts

Integrated plan, proposed specs/ADRs/architectures, guides, traceability,
roadmap, decision package, prompt catalog/hashes, integrity manifest, report,
and focused verifier.

# Stop conditions

Stop for author review if design requires productive G9, label/proximity
identity, cyclic spatial authority, render-derived DXF, nonpersistent public
objects, restricted bundle content, or weakened historical evidence.
